_comment: Known-stale evidence, waived explicitly rather than silently. .github/scripts/check_evidence_formats.py fails on any report whose recorded input hash no longer matches the committed input ('staleness is failure', klayout-tools docs/design-evidence-tiers.md). An entry here downgrades one such failure to a loud note -- and only that one: the waiver names the exact report, the exact check, and the exact stale hash. It SELF-EXPIRES: once the evidence is regenerated, the recorded_hash below no longer matches and the checker fails until the entry is deleted. Every entry must name a tracking issue. Waiving without one is a schema error, not a judgement call.

waivers.reason: Issue #579's rebase of the #571 tap-margin fix onto post-#574 main regenerated bandgap_top.gds with both fixes composed (TAP_NWELL_MARGIN_UM 0.3 + #574's Via1 Metal2-landing enclosures), so the committed post-#574 extraction's input-gds anchor names the pre-#571 GDS. The NWell margin growth is proven extraction-invariant -- extraction reads no NWell geometry; re-extracting a layout that carries every #571 geometry change except the well-margin growth produces byte-identical extraction output (see layout/README.md 'PEX re-mint deferral') -- so main's post-#574 PEX netlist is kept as the honest artifact for the merged layout rather than re-minted, protecting the actively cited item-8 characterization inventory (measurements/2026-11-18-characterization-report/ pins bandgap_top.pex.spice by hash) from a needless re-mint under a different klt build. Waived until the PEX re-mint tracked in #278/#275 lands; the entry self-expires when pex_extract_report.json is regenerated against the merged GDS.

Same deferral as bandgap_top's entry: issue #579's rebase regenerated bandgap_core.gds with #571's tap-margin fix composed onto #574's Via1 enclosures, and the committed post-#574 extraction's input-gds anchor names the pre-#571 GDS. The NWell fix is proven extraction-invariant (the fix only moves the well edge; re-extraction of a layout differing only in NWell margins is byte-identical), so main's post-#574 PEX netlist is kept for the merged layout and its anchor waived instead. Waived until the PEX re-mint tracked in #278/#275 lands; the entry self-expires when pex_extract_report.json is regenerated against the merged GDS.
